Hrasvaroma.note: King of Videha; father of Janaka and Kushadhvaja. The Janaka kings descend from Nimi, a son of Ikshvaku.

Janaka.note: Seeradhvaja Janaka, the philosopher-king of Mithila; he found the infant Sita in a furrow and gave her to whoever could string Shiva's bow.

Kushadhvaja.note: Younger brother of Janaka, king of Sankashya.

Sita.note: Found by Janaka in a furrow of the earth (Bhumija) and raised as his daughter; wife of Rama, carried off by Ravana, at last taken back into the earth. Her birth lineage is none but the Earth's.

people.Urmila: Daughter of Janaka and Sunayana; wife of Lakshmana, who slept fourteen years in her stead so he could guard Rama night and day.
people.Mandavi: Daughter of Kushadhvaja; wife of Bharata.
people.Shrutakirti: Daughter of Kushadhvaja; wife of Shatrughna.
